reason: سْمِ is governed by the prefixed بِ in the formula بِسْمِ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of سْمِ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ follows ٱللَّهِ in genitive definiteness as an adjectival divine epithet.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱللَّهِ in the same genitive adjectival series.
ٱلتِّينِ is genitive under the oath وَ at the opening of the sworn phrase.
ٱلزَّيْتُونِ is introduced by the second oath وَ and shares the sworn structure.
ٱلزَّيْتُونِ is coordinated with ٱلتِّينِ by وَ in the oath series.
طُورِ is genitive under the oath وَ continuing the sworn phrase locally.
سِينِينَ is the genitive complement of the construct طُورِ.
هَٰذَا is the sworn term introduced by وَ in this oath phrase.
ٱلْبَلَدِ specifies the demonstrative هَٰذَا as its appositional noun.
ٱلْأَمِينِ agrees with and describes ٱلْبَلَدِ.
ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ is the accusative object of خَلَقْنَا.
أَحْسَنِ is governed by فِي as the state or setting of خَلَقْنَا.
تَقْوِيمٍ is the genitive complement of the construct elative أَحْسَنِ.
The هُ suffix in رَدَدْنَٰهُ is the object pronoun after the نَا subject marker.
أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ gives the resulting state or rank of the one returned by رَدَدْنَٰهُ.
سَٰفِلِينَ is the genitive complement of the construct أَسْفَلَ.
ٱلَّذِينَ is the visible excepted term introduced by إِلَّا.
عَمِلُوا is coordinated with ءَامَنُوا by وَ in the relative clause.
ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ is the object of عَمِلُوا.
هُمْ is governed by لَ in the preposed predicate لَهُمْ for أَجْرٌ.
أَجْرٌ is the delayed subject whose predicate is the preposed لَهُمْ.
غَيْرُ describes أَجْرٌ as an indefinite nominative qualifier.
مَمْنُونٍ is the genitive complement of the construct غَيْرُ.
مَا is the interrogative subject of يُكَذِّبُكَ.
The كَ suffix in يُكَذِّبُكَ is the object pronoun of يُكَذِّبُ.
بَعْدُ is a temporal adverb modifying يُكَذِّبُكَ.
ٱلدِّينِ is governed by بِ as the complement of يُكَذِّبُكَ.
ٱللَّهُ is the nominative ism of أَلَيْسَ.
بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ is the bāʾ-marked predicate of أَلَيْسَ.
أَحْكَمِ is governed by بِ in the laysa predicate.
ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ is the genitive complement of the construct أَحْكَمِ.
